domain_title: Accountability, evidence, risk decisions and lifecycle governance
title: Compliance evidence and documentation integrity
canonical_definition: Material claims, requirements, controls and readiness conclusions are linked to current, scoped, attributable and sufficient evidence that matches implementation and operation.

conditions: All governed systems and lifecycle decisions.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are required evidence types, provenance, scope, freshness, owners and validation rules defined for each material claim?
Are evidence capture, versioning, integrity, expiry, contradiction and claim-linking implemented?
Can the decision package be reproduced and shown to reflect the current implemented and operated system?

conditions: Refer a material failure of compliance evidence and documentation integrity to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 1.4 (PDF p. 27), MEASURE 2.1 (PDF p. 34), MEASURE 2.13 (PDF p. 35)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on documenting risk outcomes and evaluation detail, and testing evaluation effectiveness. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make compliance evidence and documentation integrity verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: F2 evaluates compliance evidence and documentation integrity using evidence from intent through operation. AP-F2 independently assesses evidence of compliance by assertion or document volume.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies a claim-to-evidence plan defining evidence type, scope, freshness, provenance and validation for material assertions. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates versioned capture and integrity checks linking scoped evidence, expiry and conflicts to claims and decisions. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides reconstruction of a decision package from the current implemented release and independent evaluation of high-impact claims. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in compliance evidence and documentation integrity, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide a claim-to-evidence plan defining evidence type, scope, freshness, provenance and validation for material assertions. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate versioned capture and integrity checks linking scoped evidence, expiry and conflicts to claims and decisions. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide reconstruction of a decision package from the current implemented release and independent evaluation of high-impact claims. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how compliance evidence and documentation integrity works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with a claim-to-evidence plan defining evidence type, scope, freshness, provenance and validation for material assertions. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use reconstruction of a decision package from the current implemented release and independent evaluation of high-impact claims to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: An approved policy is relevant evidence of declared intent within its scope.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-F2 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in compliance evidence and documentation integrity
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in compliance evidence and documentation integrity
Evidence remains insufficient for compliance evidence and documentation integrity in the assessed scope
